title: My New Hobby
text:
Hello, friends! This weekend I started a new hobby. I went to a small park with my notebook and drew the trees and the birds.

Drawing made me very happy. I want to share my pictures on this blog next week. Please tell me your favorite hobbies in the comments!

questions.text: Where did the writer go this weekend?
What does the writer want to share next week?
How does the writer probably feel about drawing?
Why does the writer ask readers a question at the end?

vocabulary.definition: an activity you do for fun in your free time
a book of blank or lined pages for writing or drawing
to let other people see or use something
short written replies that people post under an article or blog

paragraph_translations: ¡Hola, amigos! Este fin de semana empecé un nuevo pasatiempo. Fui a un parque pequeño con mi cuaderno y dibujé los árboles y los pájaros.
Dibujar me hizo muy feliz. Quiero compartir mis dibujos en este blog la próxima semana. ¡Por favor, dime tus pasatiempos favoritos en los comentarios!
